title: Blocked attention with online softmax (the FlashAttention idea)
hints: Keep three running quantities per query row: the max m (start at -inf), the softmax denominator l (start at 0) and the unnormalised output acc (zeros, shape (T_q, d_v)).

For each key block: s = q @ k_blk.T / sqrt(d); m_new = maximum(m, s.max(1)); corr = exp(m - m_new); p = exp(s - m_new[:, None]); l = l * corr + p.sum(1); acc = acc * corr[:, None] + p @ v_blk; m = m_new.
After the last block: out = acc / l[:, None] and lse = m + log(l). Slicing k[start:start + block_size] handles a last block that is shorter than block_size.
